When your opponent's king is exposed in the center, look for forcing moves that drive it into danger. Here, fxe5+ gives check, forcing the king to capture. After Kxe5, the queen on f7 can deliver mate from f4 because the king has no escape squares—the pawns on d5, e6, and c5 block flight, and the queen controls all four adjacent squares. Next time you see an exposed king, calculate all forcing sequences before retreating to safety.
